I found them through a referral. I chose Build Me App because I found them to be honest and reliable.

The engagement is ongoing. We have launched our MVP and are now actively developing additional features while continuing with digital marketing efforts.

Imran and his team have been extremely supportive, responsive, and reliable throughout the process. Build Me App's biggest strength is their communication. The team has delivered good-quality work. They should keep doing what they are doing. They are the best.

**Are there any areas they could improve?**

No, they're doing their best. I see no faults with the team's work, and the manager is doing an excellent job.

**Do you have any advice for potential customers?**

Trust them. If you're a startup founder looking for a true partner who can guide you from idea to launch and beyond, Build Me App is the company to go to. They provide everything you need under one roof and deliver with quality and care.
